case.name: SQUARE_MULTI_OBJECT
case.prompt: A cinematic photograph of exactly one red vintage car on the left, one tall green tree in the center, and one small white house on the right, all on one grassy field beneath one continuous horizon, coherent perspective, no duplicate objects.

contract: shared-sigma G prediction anchors freshly noise-scaled W; both accept one Euler interval

semantic_review.object_count: Both recurrent arms produce a repeated 5x5-like lattice of cars, trees, and houses instead of exactly one of each.
semantic_review.composition: The continuous single field/horizon is replaced by stacked local scene bands; cross-tile whole-scene composition is lost.
semantic_review.credible_detail: Local objects are recognizable, but their detail is attached to duplicated independent local scenes and therefore does not satisfy the composition/detail gate.
semantic_review.feedback_localization: The two arms are identical in interval 0. Bidirectional feedback closely tracks its local assembly in middle intervals but neither creates nor repairs the repeated-object failure shared with the G-authoritative arm.
semantic_review.cause: Fresh W construction at the near-one Blueprint sigmas gives every bounded region enough independent generative freedom to instantiate the prompt as a local scene; normalized overlap cannot restore one global object layout.

decision: FAIL — FRESH SAME-SIGMA W RECONSTRUCTION FROM CLEAN G AT NEAR-ONE SIGMA LOSES S3
